content: कुण्डलिन् (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Decorated with ear-rings. .²2 Circular, spiral. .²3 Winding, coiling (as a serpent). --{%m.%} .²1 A snake. वामाङ्गीकृतवामाङ्गि कुण्डलीकृतकुण्डलि <ls>Udb.</ls> .²2 A peacock. .²3 An epithet of Varuṇa, and of Śiva. .²4 The spotted or painted deer. .²5 The golden mountain; काञ्चनाद्रौ सर्पे पुंसि तु कुण्डली <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-नी@} A form of Durgā or Śakti. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a नाडी in Yoga.
